title: MCProxy Configuration Schema
description: Configuration schema for mcproxy HTTP proxy service

headers.description: Custom headers to add to requests to the upstream server.

maxBodySize.description: Maximum request body size in bytes (overrides global limit).

timeout.description: Per-endpoint timeout in seconds (overrides global timeout).

idleTimeout.description: Maximum amount of time to wait for the next request when keep-alives are enabled (seconds)

readTimeout.description: Maximum duration for reading the entire request, including the body (seconds)

shutdownTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for graceful shutdown (seconds)

writeTimeout.description: Maximum duration before timing out writes of the response (seconds)
